title: Netting preview
lede: What this group's open commitments would come to if they were settled now. Nothing here has happened yet, and nothing on this screen changes anything.
empty: This group has no open commitments, so there is nothing to settle.

partitions.title: What netting saves
partitions.description: One plan per currency. Members are never netted across currencies, because a net across two currencies is a value that depends on a rate nobody agreed (ADR 0012).
partitions.caption: Transfers and tax, before and after netting, per currency
partitions.summary: {count, plural, one {# transfer} other {# transfers}} across {currencies, plural, one {# currency} other {# currencies}}
partitions.perCurrencyNote: Nothing is added up across currencies on this screen, and nothing should be: rupees and yen have no common total without a reporting currency and a rate.

positions.title: What each member's position comes to
positions.description: After the plan, in the currency the member holds it in.
positions.caption: Each member's position in the plan

transfers.title: Who pays whom
transfers.description: The movements the plan would make. A leg through the clearing account is the part that crosses currencies.
transfers.caption: The plan's movements
